overviewByLevel.A1: Adults and children are in a garden. A child sits on a swing. Flowers grow beside the lawn.
overviewByLevel.A2: An older man stands behind a child on a swing. A woman in white stands nearby, while two other children are beside a kneeling adult and a picnic table.
overviewByLevel.B1: Six people are grouped around a swing and picnic area. Pale clothing, a pink dress and a floral apron contrast with green grass, blue flower clusters and cream roses.
overviewByLevel.B2: The garden scene connects a rope swing beneath leafy branches with a picnic area beside a rose-covered arch. Three adults and three children occupy the lawn, while small bubbles, a woven basket and food on a blanket add details near the ground.
overviewByLevel.C1: The spherical garden surrounds a group of six people with layered planting and warm light: the hanging swing anchors one side, the kneeling adult and nearby children form another group, and the picnic table, floral arch and foreground blanket connect the human activity with the wider lawn.
